This app always runs the latest version. It checks GitHub on every launch and updates itself when a new release is out.
Suno Driver is the studio companion for the DeepSoundRealm and StillMind Music Official YouTube channels.

Type a one-line song idea and the app prepares the Suno prompt to the channel's rulebook — hook first, natural words, each channel's own style — then fills the create page and starts the generation. Everything runs on your phone, with your own Suno account.
You stay the producer: the app starts the song, you pick the take that ships.
1. Add your NVIDIA API key once — Settings, API section. It is saved on this phone only.
2. On the Write screen, type a one-line song idea and pick a channel.
3. Tap AI Write & Create. The prompt is written, Suno's create page is filled, and generation starts.
4. The first time, log in to Suno on the Suno Page tab. Your login is remembered on this phone.
5. Listen to the takes on the Suno Page and pick your favourite.
If Suno shows “Verify you are human”, open the Suno Page and tap the checkbox, then create again.
If you are signed out, log in again on the Suno Page — the create form only appears when you are signed in.
If something looks wrong, the Write screen keeps a session log. Tap Copy Logs and send them with your report.
